Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: eye-level, street-facing, fov 78
- commercial arterial road, 4-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks present, curbs present
- driveways: north entrance apron, south entrance apron
- single-story retail row under a continuous overhang building at along the back of the lot, 1 story, brick veneer, EIFS stucco panels, flat with continuous overhang roof, 60 feet from road setback
- detached end-cap retail unit building at north end of the lot, 1 story, brick veneer, metal fascia panels, flat parapet roof, 40 feet from road setback
- utilities: overhead power lines on wooden poles, transformer on rear property line pole
- landscape: parking lot islands with curbing, landscape strip along the road frontage, painted stall striping
- immutable elements: continuous storefront overhang along the retail row, pylon sign base at the road frontage, parking lot islands
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 1985
Reagan era prosperity. A 1985 strip mall at its peak — striped awnings, neon accents, every unit leased and the lot busy.

CONDITION: thriving — well-maintained, freshly painted, active business, clean lot

PERIOD DETAILS
- aerobics studio with 'AEROBICS' in neon script
- one-hour photo shop with a 'FILM DEVELOPING — 1 HOUR' sign
- nail salon with airbrushed window art
- window signs: 'NAILS $12', 'VHS RENTALS 99¢ TUESDAYS'
- arcade game posters in the arcade window
- a cart corral in the parking lot
Typography: bold geometric sans-serif, early computer-influenced fonts.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 12 people TOTAL: 5 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 4 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 3 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a woman in leg warmers entering the aerobics studio
- a man loading an electronics box into a hatchback
- a group of teenagers in bright windbreakers
Clothing: men in shoulder pads in blazers, acid wash jeans; women in leg warmers, shoulder pads. Fashion palette: neon pink, electric blue, purple. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 7 period vehicles, all different:
- 1980-1985 Cadillac Seville — sharp formal lines, bustleback — light blue
- 1979-1985 Ford LTD Country Squire — full-size woodgrain wagon — burgundy
- 1979-1985 Ford Mustang — Fox body, angular hatchback coupe — charcoal gray
- 1982-1986 Nissan Sentra — small economy boxy sedan — beige
- 1981-1985 Ford Escort — small boxy economy hatchback — silver
- 1984-1987 Toyota Corolla — boxy compact, reliable look — white
- 1984-1990 Dodge Caravan — first minivan, boxy — red
Parked with gaps; no vehicle newer than 1985.
Parked vehicles hug the curb — parallel, each facing its lane's direction; none sideways, diagonal, or against traffic. Keep at least one full driving lane clear each way for through traffic.
PLACEMENT: three parked on the RIGHT side; the rest parked on the LEFT side. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, painted crosswalks
- utilities: overhead power lines standard, wooden utility poles

TREES
- crepe myrtle tree at parking lot island near entrance: a young tree, only about 15% of its canopy in the source photo, thin trunk
- maple tree at landscape strip along the road: clearly smaller than in the source — about 35% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
- oak tree at back property line: clearly smaller than in the source — about 65% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — Kodacolor VR 200 or Fujicolor 100 look.
Color: slightly cool tones compared to 1970s. Grain: moderate grain, cleaner than 1975.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
